articles.summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. ("Peoples") (Nasdaq: PEBO) today announced results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2023. Peoples reported net income of $31.9 million for the third quarter of 2023, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.90. In comparison, Peoples reported net income of $21.1 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.64, for the second quarter of 2023, and net income of $26.0 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.92,
articles.title: PEOPLES BANCORP INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2023 RESULTS AND RECORD NET INCOME
